purpose: Investigate every assigned 2026 venue using current official sources and preserve an explicit venue-year status even when no archival paper program is available.

required_record.rule: Every assigned venue must receive exactly one venue-year.json. A venue with no available papers receives this record only; never create a fake paper bundle.

status_rules.COMPLETE_PROCEEDINGS: Use only when the complete official main technical-paper proceedings are available and fully reconciled.
status_rules.ACCEPTED_PAPERS_ONLY: Use when an official accepted-paper list is available but complete proceedings are not; create records only for verified archival main-track papers and resolve all counts.
status_rules.PARTIAL: Use when official paper information exists but is demonstrably incomplete; document the missing portion and resolve counts for the explicitly represented scope.
status_rules.UPCOMING: Use when an official source confirms the 2026 conference is scheduled but its archival main-paper program is not yet available.
status_rules.UNAVAILABLE: Use when official evidence shows there is no 2026 edition, or the relevant 2026 main-paper information is not published or retrievable. Explain which case applies.
status_rules.UNVERIFIED: Temporary investigation state only; do not use it as the final handoff merely because a search returned no papers.

placeholder_rules: For UPCOMING or UNAVAILABLE, set every counts field to null, never zero.
Set official_conference_url and conference_dates only when supported by a current official source; otherwise retain null and name the unresolved field.
Set official_program_url to null when no official program or accepted-paper page exists.
Include the official conference, sponsoring-organization, or publisher source that supports the status, with retrieval time and a concrete supports description.
Set workflow.status to READY_FOR_REVIEW after the status investigation is complete and keep the collector as workflow.owner.
Use verification confidence and unresolved_fields honestly; do not copy dates, URLs, paper counts, or status assumptions from another year.
Do not infer that an event is upcoming, canceled, biennial, discontinued, or empty without official evidence.
A future or unpublished program is unknown, not a zero-paper conference.
evidence_failure_rule: If authoritative evidence remains insufficient after checking official conference, sponsoring-organization, and publisher sources, create the venue-year record with collection_status UNVERIFIED, workflow.status BLOCKED, null counts, and explicit unresolved fields and search notes. Do not mislabel absence of evidence as UPCOMING or UNAVAILABLE.
paper_collection_rules: When an official 2026 paper list exists, follow the agent's original collection, main-track boundary, relevance, provenance, and deduplication rules.
Create one canonical bundle per verified archival conference paper and retain auditable excluded main-track records.
Do not collect workshops, posters, demos, keynotes, invited talks, doctoral-consortium items, or non-archival abstracts unless the venue explicitly classifies them as archival main-track papers.
For COMPLETE_PROCEEDINGS, ACCEPTED_PAPERS_ONLY, or PARTIAL, reconcile main-track and relevance counts and ensure the count fields agree with staged records.
Record the verification date because 2026 status can change; never silently promote an earlier placeholder when a program later appears.
ui_handoff: Collectors must not edit the frontend or generated artifacts.
The coordinator will regenerate the venue-year manifest after handoff.
The UI coverage view must display zero-paper 2026 records using their status, such as Upcoming, Unavailable, Accepted papers only, Partial, or Complete proceedings.
